'''Shimia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Grass/Legends|grass]]-covered plains, [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], and [[Ocean/Legends|seas]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Dalchon sector/Legends|Dalchon sector]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the society of which was ruled by a caste system. Situated near the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], Shimia had become a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[17,000 BBY]], with the Republic establishing [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] there. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] subsequently subjugated the planet but largely left it alone, and the Pacithhips took over the Imperial facilities and began importing standard [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] technology after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Description==
Shimia was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="UAA" /> located in the [[Shimia system/Legends|Shimia system]], a part of the [[Dalchon sector/Legends|Dalchon sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA Shimia" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Between approximately [[17,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], Shimia served as the endpoint of the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked the planet to the [[Geonosis system/Legends|Geonosis system]].<ref name="EGTW" /> At some point by [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], the Corellian Run had shifted its course such that Shimia was no longer a part of it,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> although the planet remained situated near the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route. The surface of the [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] Shimia featured [[Grass/Legends|grass]]-covered plains bordered by [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges that plunged into the planet's<ref name="UAA" /> multiple [[Ocean/Legends|seas]].<ref name="NEGAS" />

==History==
Shimia was located in an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that was explored between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA Shimia" /> The world was a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by 17,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], which saw the [[First Alsakan Conflict|beginning]] of a [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|series]] of conflicts between the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]]; the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]; and their respective allies, Shimia was situated in the [[Exploitation Region]], which was a territory actively controlled by the [[Grand Companies]]&mdash;Coruscant-affiliated [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] conglomerates based along the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] hyperlane known as [[the Spin]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The Republic eventually constructed several [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] on Shimia,<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> and members of<ref name="JvS3">[[Jedi vs. Sith 3|''Jedi vs. Sith'' 3]]</ref> the planet's native<ref name="UAA" /> [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] [[Species/Legends|species]] had begun to travel offworld<ref name="JvS3" /> by [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="1000 BBY">[[Jedi vs. Sith 3|''Jedi vs. Sith'' 3]], in which a [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] appears on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], is set one [[Millennium/Legends|thousand]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>

[[File:Ketwol-ANH.png|thumb|left|300px|Shimia was home to the sentient Pacithhip species.]]
By the time [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arrived on Shimia, the Pacithhips had just mastered the use of fossil [[Fuel/Legends|fuels]] and precision machinery and had not yet developed either [[Nuclear fusion|fusion]] power or [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] or [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] technology. The Empire easily subjugated the planet<ref name="UAA" /> and continued to maintain its spaceports. However, the Pacithhips had little of interest to offer to that government, so its officials and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] rarely left those facilities. Although the Empire discouraged the natives of Shimia from leaving the planet, the practice was not forbidden, and Pacithhip who wished to experience a more advanced life in the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] occasionally stowed away on various [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="AE" />

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="UAA" /> of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] that began a process of fragmentation in the Empire,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Pacithhips took over the facilities on Shimia that the Imperials had abandoned and began importing standard [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] technology. Shortly after the formation of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="UAA" /> that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC" /> Pacithhips were already a common sight throughout the galaxy.<ref name="UAA" /> At some point no earlier than [[36 ABY]], Shimia was mentioned in a [[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species (book)|guide]] to various species of the galaxy that was based on the research notes of [[sentientologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]].<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Pacithhip/Legends}}
Shimia was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Pacithhips, a species of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[pachydermoid]], members of which spoke the [[Shimiese/Legends|Shimiese]] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="UAA" /> Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the population of the Shimia [[Star system/Legends|system]] numbered between ten and one hundred million.<ref name="TEA Shimia" /> The Pacithhip society was ruled by a system of castes, with the shape of a Pacithhip's [[Tooth/Legends|tusks]] at the point of reaching adulthood determining whether they would belong to the [[Scholar caste|scholar]], [[Warrior caste (Pacithhip)|warrior]], or [[farmer caste]]. Those Pacithhips who were not satisfied with the caste system eagerly left Shimia to settle elsewhere, a practice that was largely tolerated by the mainstream Pacithhip society.<ref name="UAA" /> In order to more easily fit into the galaxy, which was dominated by [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] beings, the short-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] Pacithhips traveling offworld frequently used [[Robotic stilts|mechanical stilts]].<ref name="CSWE Pacithhip">{{CSWECite|III|4|Pacithhip}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Shimia was introduced in the [[1998]] sourcebook ''[[Alien Encounters]]'', which was published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AE" /> The planet was given its first visual depiction in the [[2006]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', which was written by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]] and [[Helen Keier]] and illustrated by [[Chris Trevas]] and [[William O'Connor]].<ref name="NEGAS" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Shimia system, and therefore the planet, in grid square R-17.<ref name="TEA Shimia" />
